$comment: MACHINE half of the /sessions contract; the HUMAN half (why/when, decision tables) is sessions.md. The service imports this file for request validation and the response/error envelopes — never re-declared in code. `x-requirements` couples shapes to requirement IDs; scripts/spec_gate.py fails CI on orphans in either direction and on `errors` keys the page never mentions.

stack.description: AgentStack name (e.g. platform, oracle) — a key of the policy's `stacks`

message.description: one line, never containing a credential value

caller.$comment: GW-SESSIONS-AUTH — every POST /sessions, GET /sessions/{id} and DELETE /sessions/{id} carries `Authorization: Bearer <the caller's projected ServiceAccount token, audience agent-gateway>`, TokenReview'd through the same path as the pull. The reviewed username is looked up in the policy's `callers` map; under `control_plane_auth: observe` an absent or invalid token is admitted (and counted), under `enforce` it is refused. Not a body field: a header, so no request shape changes.

task.description: opaque task key (e.g. homelab-2588-r1); never a metric label

harness.description: default from policy roles.<role>.harness; fixes the dialect the walk may use

pod.description: the pod's name; absent = any pod of the ServiceAccount (⚖)

bind.description: the identity that may pull this session's env (POST /sessions/{id}/env); present = the dispatch answer carries no token and no env values

token.description: returned ONCE; stored only as sha256

model.description: the policy id for (rail, tier) — the only place a model id comes from

env.description: the pod's COMPLETE LLM env for the harness; the launcher copies it verbatim

context_tokens.description: the policy's declared window for the model; null = not declared, never a guess

dispatch_bound.description: the answer to a body carrying `bind`: no token, no env values — the bound pod pulls them

env_keys.description: the NAMES of the env the pull returns, in GW-SESSIONS-ENV's order

reason.description: rail-capacity = every slot taken; rail-window = a window utilization or Go window draw at its threshold; rail-latched = an upstream 429 latch (sessions.md §Capacity); quota-* = the codex rail's headroom verdicts (GW-CODEX-HEADROOM, openai-responses.md); the reason and retry_after_s name the blocked rail that frees first

retry_after_s.description: seconds until the first blocked rail may admit: a window reset, a latch expiry, or the policy defer_retry_s for a full rail

tokens_in.description: uncached input tokens (openai dialect: prompt_tokens - cached_tokens)

caller.description: the admitting caller's reviewed ServiceAccount username; null = admitted with no valid caller token (control_plane_auth observe)

pull.$comment: POST /sessions/{id}/env — the bound pod's env pull. Request: no body; `Authorization: Bearer <projected ServiceAccount token, audience agent-gateway>`.

env.description: exactly the env GW-SESSIONS-ENV hands an unbound dispatch, carrying the token minted at this pull

malformed-body.description: the request body fails this schema's `post.input` (missing field, enum miss, negative round)

harness-rail-mismatch.description: an explicit `harness` and `rail` whose dialects do not meet (goose/opencode x anthropic, codex x anything but codex, claude x codex)

session-not-found.description: GET, DELETE or a pull on an id no row carries (GET / DELETE: after the caller check)

pull-identity-refused.description: the pull's bearer is absent, does not authenticate, lacks audience agent-gateway, or is not the bind's ServiceAccount (and pod); also any pull of an unbound session

tokenreview-transient.description: the TokenReview API failed or was unreachable — nothing is known about the caller; retry (a pull, or a control-plane call under enforce)

caller-unauthenticated.description: control_plane_auth enforce: the control-plane call carries no bearer, or one that does not review as authenticated for audience agent-gateway

caller-unknown.description: the caller's reviewed ServiceAccount is not a key of the policy's `callers` (both modes)

caller-stack-denied.description: the body's `stack` is not in the caller's `stacks`

caller-role-denied.description: the body's `role` is not in the caller's `roles`

caller-bind-denied.description: the body's `bind.namespace` is not in the caller's `bind_namespaces`

caller-not-owner.description: GET or DELETE of a session another caller admitted

env-already-delivered.description: the session's env was already pulled — at most once

session-released.description: a pull of a released session — the data plane's verdict

session-expired.description: a pull of an expired session — the data plane's verdict

credential-transient.description: the kube API failed or was unreachable while resolving a ref — nothing is known about the credential; retry
